{C:8190B501}{C:819582962B2900000000}Are you going into town?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962C2900000000}Yes, that's what I was planning.

{C:8190B501}{C:819582962D2900000000}I'll come with you.
I sense something strange.

{C:8190B601}{C:819582962E2900000000}Something strange?

{C:8190B501}{C:819582962F2900000000}I can't put it into words.

{C:81958296302900000000}Rie, Nelfea,
you two should stay out of trouble too.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296312900000000}Mr. Kasshu, you're sooo bossy!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296322900000000}Just stay here, all right?

{C:81958296332900000000}Sai Saici,
come with me.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296AE0000000000}You got it!

{C:8190B901}{C:81958296342900000000}We'll come along as well.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296352900000000}No, George, you and the others
should stay on the Astante.
There's no telling what might happen.

{C:8190B701}{C:81958296362900000000}OK!
Leave things here to us.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296372900000000}Then let's go.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296502900000000}Still, what was the deal
with those people?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296B00000000000}Seriously!
They came out of nowhere.

{C:8190AE02}{C:81958296512900000000}I see.
Thank you.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296B10000000000}Huh?
We've got a visitor.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296522900000000}Hey, Rie!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296532900000000}Oh, welcome back,
big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296542900000000}Who was that just now?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296552900000000}He said he was looking for some boys about his age.
He mentioned a few names,
like Ryo and Shu.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296562900000000}I see.
Be careful, though.
Some weird people attacked us earlier.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296572900000000}Were you all right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296582900000000}I was, thanks to having Domon and the others with us.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296B20000000000}Who are you?!

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296592900000000}We're...

{C:8190B501}{C:819582965B2900000000}You're back again!
I won't lose this time!!

{C:8190AA02}{C:819582965C2900000000}No, you've got it wrong!
We realized it was a misunderstanding and came to apologize.
And we have a favor to ask.

{C:8190AB02}{C:819582965D2900000000}We're sorry.
We apologize for using force
for such selfish reasons.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E2900000000}What do you think, Domon?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296602900000000}You don't look like bad people,
and it seems there's more to this.
Would you tell us about it?

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296612900000000}The truth is, we're fighting the Yoja too...
To put it simply,
we're fighting bad people.

{C:81958296622900000000}For some reason, they were after two girls.
We were protecting them,
but they were finally taken from us...

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296632900000000}The one who took them used
a martial arts stance like yours,
so we assumed you were on the same side.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296B30000000000}The same stance as Domon?
...Master?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296642900000000}Master?!
There's no way he'd do anything evil!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296652900000000}Eiji,
you know my teacher?!

{C:81902201}{C:81958296662900000000}Master taught me
how to fight.

{C:81958296672900000000}Your teacher? Then you're
the idiot pupil Master told me about...

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296682900000000}Who are you calling an idiot pupil?! Who?!

{C:81902201}{C:819582966A2900000000}I'm sorry.
That's what Master called you.

{C:8190AD02}{C:819582966B2900000000}Sorry to interrupt,
but could you let us
aboard this ship?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966C2900000000}Why?

{C:8190AC02}{C:819582966D2900000000}Shu, that's too sudden.

{C:819582966E2900000000}The girls we're looking for
are called Natsumi
and Mirai.

{C:819582966F2900000000}We've searched everywhere we could think of,
but they don't seem to be
on this continent anymore.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296702900000000}So we want to go looking
on the other continents.
Could you let us aboard?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296712900000000}What do you think, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296722900000000}Oh, this is a tough one...

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296732900000000}I'm asking you too.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296742900000000}Domon?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296752900000000}I'm asking you too.
If we go with him, I'm sure we'll understand
what Master really intends.

{C:81958296762900000000}Don't you agree, Domon?

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296772900000000}Yes, exactly.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296782900000000}All right.
You have permission to come aboard.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296792900000000}Thank you.







{x00}

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296262800000000}Have you lot seen
a child with a baby?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296282800000000}A child with a baby?
We haven't seen one so far.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296292800000000}Is it your child?

{C:8190B102}{C:819582962A2800000000}Don't be impertinent!

{C:81900300}{C:819582962B2800000000}Oh dear, now he's angry.

{C:81900400}{C:819582962C2800000000}It doesn't matter.
He's obviously suspicious,
so we don't have to give him a proper answer.

{C:81900300}{C:819582962D2800000000}Is that how it works?

{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296ED3600000000}Excuse me. Could I
see Lady Haman?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EE3600000000}Haman?
Um, please wait a moment.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF3600000000}Has anyone
seen Haman?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296F13600000000}Haman?
I thought she was right there a moment ago...

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296F23600000000}Did you want something with me?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F33600000000}Oh, Haman.
Someone's here
who wants to see you.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296F43600000000}Ah, it's you.
Is something wrong?


{C:8193BA00}{C:81958296F53600000000}We've finished analyzing the data you gave us,
and the machine is ready.


{C:81909E00}{C:81958296F63600000000}I see. Thank you for your work.
Have the machine brought aboard the ship.


{C:8193BA00}{C:81958296F73600000000}Understood.
And about that Zeta...


{C:81909E00}{C:81958296F83600000000}I know!
Proceed with that matter as before.

{C:8190BA00}{C:81958296F93600000000}Yes, ma'am. I'll see to it.
I'll meet you here again later, then.


{C:81909E00}{C:81958296FA3600000000}It seems the new machine has arrived.
Give it to Char.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB3600000000}...Char?
Oh, you mean Lieutenant Quattro.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296FC3600000000}Oh, yes. Quattro, wasn't it?
I've had a machine prepared especially for him,
so let him use it.

{C:81958296FD3600000000}I'm sure he'll be delighted.
Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FE3600000000}(What does she
find so funny?)



{x00}

Do you know her?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296630100000000}Sis!

{C:81909700}{C:819582967B3600000000}Big brother!

{C:81930100}{C:819582967C3600000000}Huh? Rie didn't come along, did she?
Lun, was that you?

{C:81900200}{C:819582967D3600000000}Of course it wasn't.
Or do you want me to call you
'big brother'?

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F3600000000}No, that's not what I meant.

{C:81909700}{C:81958296803600000000}Big brother, I'm talking to you!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296843600000000}Kamille, I didn't know you had a sister.

Hey, you...

{C:81909700}{C:81958296873600000000}It's Rosammy.

{C:81909700}{C:81958296883600000000}You've forgotten

That's so mean...

{C:81908200}{C:81958296893600000000}I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
I just couldn't remember for a moment.

{C:81909700}{C:819582968A3600000000}Then will you stay with me now?
I'm never leaving you!
